verdicts.reason: A: the logo has been pulled out of the card and floats alone on the gradient, and it appears to have lost its red swoosh. The card has dead space above the headline and a large empty gap before the CTA, and the CTA is centred while the copy is left-aligned. B is worse: the card runs off the top and right edges, the CTA sits at the very top ahead of the headline so the reading order is reversed, logo and CTA float apart in a header row, and a huge void separates them from the headline, which itself sits far from its supporting line.
